test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which indigenous aircraft carrier was delivered to Indian Navy on July 28, 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **On September 2, 2022, Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi** commissioned the country's first indigenous aircraft carrier,** Indian Naval Ship (INS) Vikrant, at Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) and unveiled the new Naval Ensign (Nishaan).**
 
• **The Prime Minister described INS Vikrant** as a testament to India's **hard work, talent, influence, and commitment in the 21st century**, and a reflection of India becoming self-reliant.
 
• He acknowledged and praised the contribution of the **Navy, engineers of Cochin Shipyard, scientists, and workers who worked on the project.**
 
• **INS Vikrant** is a symbol of indigenous **potential, resources, and skills.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Prime Minister also talked about the** Indian Maritime tradition** and **naval capabilities**, and noted that the new Navy flag, inspired by Chhatrapati Shivaji, will fly in the sea and in the sky.
 
• He praised the role of women soldiers in the Navy and announced that all branches of the Navy will be open to women.
 
• He emphasized the need for every citizen to live the mantra of 'Vocal for Local' to make the country self-reliant.
